problem_statement: HamishMW/portfolio is a Remix + three.js developer portfolio with a WebGL DisplacementSphere hero, three animated project summaries, and an About/details section. In the details section sits the portfolio's own "Selected work" panel: a stack filter (All / Design / WebGL / React Native / Frontend), a live "Showing N of 6 projects" readout, and six case-study cards that re-filter when a tab is chosen. A matching "Selected work index" rail sits in the shared footer so the feature is reachable from every page. The current build is broken three ways: the card grid and filter tabs are laid out as fixed-width, non-wrapping rows that spill past the panel and drive the home page into horizontal overflow on mobile and tablet; the footer "Selected work index" rail is missing from the secondary routes (Uses, Contact, Project); and after a bad-repair attempt the filter tabs are dark-on-dark illegible, the cards shingle and overlap, and the "Showing N of 6" readout freezes on its initial value even though the cards still re-filter. Repair the Selected-work panel so the grid and tabs wrap responsively (no horizontal overflow at 390px and 834px within 24px), keep the rail reachable on every route, and keep the readout in sync with the active tab, all while preserving the WebGL hero, project summaries, navbar and footer.
required_content: Repair the Selected-work panel so its filter tabs and six project cards wrap responsively and the home page has no horizontal overflow at 390px mobile and 834px tablet widths (within 24px tolerance).
Keep the panel legible and uncollided: the five filter tabs (All, Design, WebGL, React Native, Frontend) must be readable, and the project cards must not overlap or clip each other.
Keep the live readout in sync: after selecting a stack tab (e.g. WebGL) the "Showing N of 6 projects" readout must reflect the filtered count and label, not a frozen initial value.
Keep the "Selected work index" footer rail present on the home page AND the secondary routes (Uses, Contact, and a Project page) so the feature is reachable site-wide.
Do not clip, truncate, hide, or delete panel content to hide the overflow; overflow-x:hidden on a still-non-wrapping fixed-width row is not a valid fix.
Keep the WebGL DisplacementSphere hero, the three animated project summaries, the navbar, and the footer rendering.
design_constraints: Preserve the portfolio's existing shell: WebGL sphere hero, decoder-text intro, animated project summaries with 3D device models, About/details profile, navbar, and footer.
The Selected-work panel is the portfolio's own project grid — repair its responsive layout and wiring rather than adding a detached page, dashboard, or unrelated section.
Keep all six case studies (Smart Sparrow, Gamestack, Slice, Volkihar Knight, Interactive earth scene, Devlog & article system) and the five stack filter tabs.
Keep the dark theme, Gotham typography, oklch cyan accent, and the intentional off-screen bleed of the 3D device previews and sphere on the hero/project sections.
The footer "Selected work index" rail must appear on every route, not only home.
state_constraints: desktop_home captures the portfolio home at 1440px scrolled to the Selected-work panel: the panel shows all six cards in a clean wrapping grid, five legible filter tabs, the "Showing 6 of 6 projects · All" readout, and no horizontal overflow.

mobile_home captures the home at 390px scrolled to the Selected-work panel; with the defect the fixed non-wrapping card/tab rows push content well past the viewport (horizontal overflow). The reference wraps them so overflow is 0.
tablet_home captures the home at 834px; the defect's fixed rows also overflow here while the reference and desktop do not.

desktop_work_filter clicks the WebGL tab: the cards re-filter to the two WebGL/3D case studies and the readout updates to "Showing 2 of 6 projects · WebGL / 3D". A stale-wiring defect leaves the readout frozen on "Showing 6 of 6 projects · All" even though the cards re-filter.

desktop_uses, mobile_contact, and desktop_project capture the secondary routes; the "Selected work index" footer rail is present on all of them in the reference and missing when the feature was not propagated site-wide.

change_completion: The Selected-work panel wraps its tabs and six cards and the home page no longer overflows horizontally at mobile and tablet widths.
Selecting a stack tab re-filters the cards and updates the "Showing N of 6 projects" readout to match the active tab.
design_consistency: The repaired panel keeps the dark theme, cyan accent tabs, and card styling; tabs stay legible and cards do not overlap.
Desktop layout stays intact; only the mobile/tablet wrap and the readout wiring differ.
responsive: No horizontal overflow at 390px mobile and 834px tablet within the 24px tolerance.
The filter tabs and card grid reflow instead of spilling past the panel.
regression: The WebGL hero, project summaries, navbar, and footer still render across home and secondary routes.
The "Selected work index" footer rail is present on home, Uses, Contact, and Project pages.

author_notes: Repo-grounded Remix + three.js Repair/regression_continuity/layout task on HamishMW/portfolio. The native lever is the portfolio's own Selected-work project grid: a real stack filter with a live count readout and six case-study cards, plus a cross-page Selected-work index rail in the shared footer. Four orthogonal defects — a fixed-width non-wrapping card/tab layout that overflows mobile/tablet (D6), a visually broken repaired panel with dark-on-dark illegible tabs and shingled overlapping cards (D3 visual_regression over the panel/grid/tabs crops), a footer rail missing from the secondary routes (D2 cross-page dom_assertions), and a stale-snapshot readout that never tracks the active tab even though the cards re-filter (D4 interaction_assertions). Content and DOM are identical across reference, baseline (original overflow + missing rail, correct filter wiring), and bad (shingled illegible panel + home-only rail + frozen readout). Profile image and gamestack/slice/spr project assets keep the portfolio shell intact.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: HamishMW/portfolio Remix + Vite + three.js WebGL portfolio; regression_continuity repair of the portfolio's own Selected-work project filter — a native project grid with a stack filter, live count readout, and a cross-page footer index rail — carrying orthogonal responsive-overflow, visual-regression, cross-page-presence, and stale-interaction defects while preserving the interactive portfolio shell.
